responsibility: This target configuration header defines the driver self-specs for MIPS Technologies ELF toolchains. It ensures the ISA level is made explicit, infers floating-point and synci defaults from -march, derives the default ABI and FP ABI where needed, guarantees an explicit endianness option for later specs, and then applies the common base MIPS driver rules, so its focus is multilib and option normalization for MTI bare-metal ELF targets.
